graphics.quality.ultra_low: Applies the Ultra Low quality preset for maximum performance.
graphics.quality.low: Applies the Low quality preset for optimized performance.
graphics.quality.mid: Applies the Mid quality preset for balanced graphics and performance.
graphics.quality.high: Applies the High quality preset for superior graphics quality.
graphics.anisotropy: Enhances texture clarity at oblique viewing angles.
graphics.vsync: Synchronizes frame rendering with display refresh rate to eliminate screen tearing.
graphics.fps_limit: Caps the maximum frame rate when VSync is disabled.
graphics.lod_bias: Adjusts the level of detail for distant objects. Lower values keep details sharp at distance, higher values reduce detail to improve performance.
graphics.night_mode: Toggles night time rendering for the sky and environment.
graphics.clouds: Enables volumetric cloud layers in the sky.
graphics.cloud_coverage: Controls the density and coverage of volumetric clouds.
graphics.cloud_density: Adjusts the thickness and opacity of the volumetric clouds.
graphics.bloom_enabled: Toggles the Bloom effect, making bright highlights glow.
graphics.bloom_strength: Controls how bright the bloom glow is.
graphics.bloom_threshold: Determines how bright a pixel must be before it starts glowing.
graphics.bloom_radius: Controls how far the bloom light disperses across the screen.
graphics.aces_enabled: Toggles ACES Tonemapping for a cinematic filmic look.
graphics.aces_exposure: Adjusts the overall exposure of the scene.
graphics.cg_contrast: Adjusts the contrast between light and dark areas.
graphics.cg_saturation: Adjusts the intensity of colors in the scene.
graphics.vignette_enabled: Toggles Vignette, darkening the edges of the screen.
graphics.vignette_intensity: Controls how far and dark the vignette reaches into the screen.
graphics.chroma_enabled: Toggles Chromatic Aberration, splitting colors at the screen edges.
graphics.chroma_strength: Controls the distance colors separate from each other.
graphics.dof_enabled: Toggles Depth of Field, blurring objects out of focus.
memu.create.new_scene: Creates a new empty scene, resetting the current workspace.
memu.create.new_explorer: Opens a system file explorer dialog to browse and load existing 3D animatrix workspace files or saved timelines.
memu.create.new_save: Saves the current scene properties, model instances, and keyframe timeline tracks to the active workspace file path.
memu.create.new_save_as: Saves the current animatrix project state to a new custom file location on your disk.
memu.exit: Gracefully terminates the Unify Studio X engine runtime loop and saves configurations.
memu.undo: Reverts the last performed scene action, object transform adjustment, or keyframe modification.
memu.redo: Re-applies the last reverted scene action, object transform adjustment, or keyframe modification.
memu.cut: Removes the currently selected scene entity or keyframe block and places it onto the editor clipboard.
